provenance_policy.REAL: Facility-specific fact directly supported by reliable evidence.
provenance_policy.REAL_REFERENCE: Real/reference information useful for network construction.
provenance_policy.ESTIMATED_SUPPORTED: Estimated value supported by cited range or contextual evidence.
provenance_policy.REFERENCE_STANDARD: Generic healthcare or government standard used as a reference constraint.
provenance_policy.DERIVED: Calculated from existing dataset fields (e.g. nearest neighbors distance).
provenance_policy.SIMULATED: Synthetic operational data created because facility-level historical data is unavailable.
